messages:
olivia: Heads-up — noticed a spike in inspect capture queue this morning for prod-route /v1/generate. Some samples include unredacted user snippets. Anyone else seeing backpressure?
hamid: saw alerts — sampler consumer lag jumped ~8k msgs at 03:12 UTC. Might be caused by downstream redis slow. Investigating.
pj: can we flip inspect capture to minimal-mode as quick mitigation? ops have a toggle in console but need runbook.
sre-bot: alert: sampler-consumer-lag > 5k for 2m on prod-cluster-3
maya: agreed with pj. Suggest rate-limit inspect capture per-tenant + fallback to hashed fingerprints.
kevin: if we flip to minimal-mode we lose some debug traces for canaries — can we do per-route rather than global?
olivia: yes per-route would be ideal. but console UI currently only exposes global inspect toggle. We need a fast path: api to patch route sampling.
hamid: we already have internal admin API: POST /admin/routes/{route}/sampling with body { "inspect_level": "minimal", "sample_rate": 0.05 } — but it's guarded. Maybe allow emergency flag for oncall.
pj: example payload:
```
POST /admin/routes/prod/v1/generate/sampling
{
  "inspect_enabled": false,
  "sample_rate": 0.01,
  "redact_mode": "strict"
}
```
olivia: +1 to redact_mode strict for now. Also need to scrub attachments and embeddings. Found a sample log where email not redacted:
```
REQ id=abc123 route=/v1/generate user="jane@example.com" prompt="My SSN is 123-45-6789"
```
kevin: ouch. That indicates our PII heuristics missed the email because it was URL-encoded. We should run a pre-scrub decode step.
maya: can we add a temporary pipeline step in ingress that base64/url-decodes before scrub? low-risk and reversible.
hamid: deployable as a dynamic feature flag. I'll create a canary for the decode pre-scrub only for 1% traffic.
pj: UX: console needs a visible "emergency scrub" action that oncall can trigger which does: set per-route inspect to minimal, enforce strict redact, rotate ephemeral keys (if any), and log the action in audit.
olivia: agree — audit entry and TTL for the action (auto-revert in 30m) important.
kevin: operational note: make sure this action doesn't break replay pipelines. add a "dry-run" first that shows estimated samples affected.
hamid: creating PR for admin-api flag + feature: PR #4287 (WIP)
pj: tagging legal and security: @legal @security — we might need to notify customers for any PII exposure per policy.
maya: pinged security. they asked for initial blast radius estimate and sample id list.
olivia: can someone run quick query to list sample ids from lag window? something like:
```
SELECT sample_id, route, tenant FROM telemetry.samples WHERE created_ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' AND redacted=false LIMIT 500;
```
hamid: running now, will paste results in thread.
sre-bot: deploy: rollout admin-api patch to canary (canary-2) started by hamid
hamid: query results: 42 unredacted samples found, mostly from tenant 'sandbox-app', two from 'customer-x'. I'll redact and delete copies, and push canary decode pre-scrub.
kevin: after canary, plan a console UX follow-up: add per-route emergency actions + a visible "last audit action" badge next to route in route-list.
pj: also propose a telem dashboard card that shows 'unredacted samples' count, with links to open legal-safe export.
olivia: thanks everyone — hamid pls coordinate with security/legal and post the audit log here. I'll schedule a quick 15m oncall call if needed. :thumbsup:
